**Security: pass-with-notes** at `a438316f839500f6e67a9364717f012ed7f7f005`.

Req-10's statement and completion target match F88's actual root; this is approval of the requirement, not evidence that its controls are implemented or that the bootstrap workshop is approved.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| 0 | None | N/A | N/A | No reportable vulnerability in the specification | N/A |

Req-10 requires privately bootstrapped per-incarnation proof, prohibits capability recovery using victim identifiers alone, and requires proof before seat/parent/prime/holder/owner/recipient comparisons (`docs/project/prds/003-seat-permissions.dd.json:175-181`). It targets all caller-dependent classes, not just #153's activity grant or claimed-host validation.

The completion target retains shipping-head inventory and route-class regressions (`docs/project/workstreams/003-seat-permissions.dd.json:23-28`). Future evidence must exercise issuer/reissue resistance, native/manual inbox lifecycle, controls, protected reads, attribution and shared-handler write aliases, including separate sessions sharing one Copilot host. Ancestry alone cannot satisfy that session-ownership requirement. Intentional machine-public operations need no invented holder-only restriction.

Req-11's prime-designation authorization remains distinct (`docs/project/prds/003-seat-permissions.dd.json:184-191`). All eleven requirements/five steps are planned; coverage is not delivery. q-02 to q-04 remain open under the explicit merge ruling, with later policy work waiting on them. q-01 aligns with the audited-force policy. Draft PRD metadata is not a blocker.

No prohibited private owner/name/content, foreign-machine paths or secrets found in introduced sources, renders or public PR body. Owned governance-note references do not publish their contents.

**Nonblocking truth note:** the changelog already says "Merged to main" (`docs/project/prds/003-seat-permissions.dd.json:251`). Until actual merge, that is merge intent, not completed-merge evidence.

**Proof:** exact-head CI [42403553717](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42403553717), attempt 1, passed all four jobs. Schema/render/acceptance checks were static; author-reported DD receipts were not rerun. No local builds/tests, credential/private-history/store reads, live probes or product edits. No permission policy or runtime-security completion is claimed.
